act_name: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 (Punjab Act XLII of 2012)
title: Taxable service
text: A taxable service is a service listed in the Second Schedule to this Act which is provided: (a) by a registered person from his registered office or place of business in the Punjab; or (b) to a resident person in the Punjab by a person outside the Punjab.
source_file: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 (Punjab Act XLII of 2012)
text_normalized: A taxable service is a service listed in the Second Schedule to this Act which is provided: (a) by a registered person from his registered office or place of business in the Punjab; or (b) to a resident person in the Punjab by a person outside the Punjab.

act_name: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 (Punjab Act XLII of 2012)
title: Scope of tax and general rate
text: Subject to the provisions of this Act, there shall be levied and collected a tax called the Punjab sales tax on the value of a taxable service at the rate specified in the Second Schedule, provided that the standard rate of tax shall be sixteen percent.
source_file: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 (Punjab Act XLII of 2012)

act_name: Punjab Sales Tax on Services Act, 2012 (Punjab Act XLII of 2012)
title: Appeals to Commissioner (Appeals)
text: Any person aggrieved by any order passed by an officer of the Punjab Revenue Authority (PRA) may, within thirty days of the date of communication of the order, appeal to the Commissioner (Appeals).
